fullDescription: A clean, light SaaS landing page built around an infinite logo-marquee carousel: a sticky frosted white nav (a teal rounded-square carousel-icon logo + a 'Carousel' wordmark, a hidden-on-mobile link row -- Customers / Product / Library / Pricing -- a ghost 'Sign in' link and a solid teal 'Start free' pill, plus a mobile hamburger), then a centered grid-textured hero (a teal 'Design system, generated in seconds' status pill, a big 'Ship interfaces the whole world already recognizes' heading whose 'recognizes' is teal with a hand-drawn SVG underline swash, a soft lead, and a primary teal 'Generate your first design' button + a ghost 'Watch the canvas' button). The anchor section is a two-row trusted-by logo marquee: 'Trusted by design & product teams at', then two edge-faded infinite-scroll rows of icon+wordmark logo chips (the top row scrolls left at 40s, the bottom row scrolls right at 28s), each row duplicated twice so the CSS translateX(-50%) loop is seamless, with a left/right transparent mask fade at the edges and a hover-to-pause + per-logo teal tint. Below it: a 4-up metric trust strip (57k+ / 2.4M / 4.9/5 / 12s) in a hairline-divided rounded card, a 3-up feature grid (Prompt to mockup / Infinite canvas / Clean export), a teal gradient CTA card with corner glow blobs, and a social footer. Inter font, teal #0f766e + #0d6660 + #115e59 accents on a slate #f8fafc ground, Iconify Phosphor icons, and a responsive reflow that collapses the nav into a hamburger.

structured.summary: A clean, light SaaS landing page anchored on an infinite logo-marquee carousel, in a confident, friendly product-marketing voice. A sticky frosted white top nav (a teal rounded-square logo chip holding a ph:carousel-bold icon + a 'Carousel' wordmark, a hidden-on-mobile link row -- Customers / Product / Library / Pricing -- a ghost 'Sign in' link, a solid teal 'Start free' pill, and a md:hidden hamburger) sits above a centered, grid-textured hero: a teal 'Design system, generated in seconds' status pill, a big two-line 'Ship interfaces the whole world already recognizes' heading whose final word 'recognizes' is teal with a hand-drawn SVG underline swash beneath it, a muted lead, and a button pair (a solid teal 'Generate your first design' button with an arrow + a white-bordered ghost 'Watch the canvas' button with a play-circle icon). The centerpiece is a TWO-ROW logo marquee 'trusted by' section: an uppercase tracked 'Trusted by design & product teams at' label, then two edge-faded, overflow-hidden rows of logo chips that scroll infinitely on a CSS keyframe -- the top row translates left (40s), the bottom row translates right (28s) -- each built in JS from a logo list, rendered as icon+wordmark chips (a rounded slate icon square + a bold wordmark) and DUPLICATED so a translateX(-50%) loop is seamless; the edges fade to transparent via a CSS mask, hovering pauses the animation, and hovering a single logo tints it teal. Below the marquee: a 4-up metric trust strip (57k+ designers / 2.4M designs / 4.9/5 rating / 12s idea-to-mockup) laid out as a hairline-divided rounded card, a 3-up feature grid (Prompt to mockup / Infinite canvas / Clean export) of bordered cards that lift on hover, a teal gradient CTA card with blurred corner glow blobs and a faint grid texture, and a social footer (brand + copyright + x/github/discord icons). Built on the Tailwind CDN with Inter and Iconify Phosphor icons; below md the nav links collapse into the hamburger, the hero heading and buttons scale and stack, and the metric strip drops from 4 to 2 columns.

style.description: A clean, light, trustworthy SaaS aesthetic: a soft slate ground (#f8fafc) with crisp white surfaces and a single disciplined teal accent family (teal-600 #0f766e, teal-700 #0d6660, teal-800 #115e59, with teal-50 #f0fdfa and teal-100 #ccfbf1 tints). Body text is near-black 'ink' (#0b1220) with slate-600 (#475569) supporting copy and slate-500 (#64748b) labels. Teal carries every primary action and brand mark: the solid teal nav 'Start free' pill and hero 'Generate your first design' button (white text, soft teal-tinted shadow shadow-teal-600/25-30), the teal logo chip, teal status-pill text on a teal-50 fill with a teal-600/20 border, teal section eyebrows, the teal stat numbers, the hand-drawn teal underline swash under the hero word, and a teal-700 gradient CTA card. Hover states resolve toward teal: nav links and footer icons go teal-700, feature cards gain a teal-600/40 border, and individual marquee logos tint teal (icon + wordmark to teal-600, icon chip background to teal-100). Surfaces are airy: hairline slate-200 borders, generous rounding (rounded-full pills/buttons, rounded-2xl feature + metric cards, rounded-3xl CTA card, rounded-xl logo + icon chips), and soft shadows (shadow-sm on the nav pill, shadow-lg shadow-slate-200/60 on hovered feature cards). Texture and atmosphere are subtle: a faint 44px teal grid behind the hero (grid lines at rgba(15,118,110,0.05)), a thin teal top hairline gradient on the hero, and on the CTA card two large blurred teal glow blobs (teal-400/30 top-right, teal-900/60 bottom-left) plus a faint 36px white grid. Typography is a single Inter family across weights 400-900, leaning on extrabold (800) for the hero, section headings, stat numbers and logo wordmarks, with tight tracking on big headings; Iconify Phosphor (ph:) icons throughout. The overall feel is bright, credible and motion-light, with the marquee providing the only continuous animation.
style.prompt: Use a clean, light SaaS design system on the Tailwind CDN with Inter (the only font) and Iconify Phosphor icons. Extend the Tailwind theme: `fontFamily.sans = ['Inter','system-ui','sans-serif']`, and custom colors `teal: { 600: '#0f766e', 700: '#0d6660', 800: '#115e59', 50: '#f0fdfa', 100: '#ccfbf1' }`, `ink: '#0b1220'`, `slate: { 50: '#f8fafc' }`. Load Inter (weights 400;500;600;700;800;900) from Google Fonts and Iconify 3.1.1 from https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js. Body is `font-sans text-ink antialiased` with `body { background: #f8fafc }` and `html { scroll-behavior: smooth }`. The ground is slate-50 (#f8fafc); surfaces are white. Use ONE accent family -- teal -- for all brand + action: the teal-600 logo chip and 'Start free' / 'Generate your first design' buttons (white text, `shadow-sm shadow-teal-600/30` and `shadow-lg shadow-teal-600/25`, hover bg-teal-700), teal-700 link/icon hovers, a teal-50 status pill with `text-teal-700` and a `border-teal-600/20` border, `text-teal-700` section eyebrows and stat numbers, and a teal-700 gradient CTA card. Text: headings + stats + logo wordmarks in `font-extrabold` (Inter 800) near-black ink (#0b1220) with `tracking-tight`; body copy in slate-600; small labels in slate-500 (uppercase + `tracking-[0.18em]` for the 'trusted by' line). Rounding: `rounded-full` pills/buttons, `rounded-2xl` feature + metric cards, `rounded-3xl` CTA card, `rounded-xl` logo chips + icon squares. Borders: hairline `border-slate-200`; feature cards go `hover:border-teal-600/40 hover:bg-white hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-slate-200/60`. Texture: a `.grid-bg` 44px teal line grid (`linear-gradient` lines at `rgba(15,118,110,0.05)`, `background-size: 44px 44px`) behind the hero, a thin `bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-teal-600/30 to-transparent` top hairline on the hero, and on the CTA card two blurred glow blobs (`bg-teal-400/30 blur-3xl` top-right, `bg-teal-900/60 blur-3xl` bottom-left) over a faint 36px white grid at opacity .07. The only continuous motion is the logo marquee (two CSS keyframe-animated rows); buttons and cards use simple `transition` hovers.

layout_and_structure.description: A single light scrolling landing page: a sticky nav, a grid-textured hero, then the two-row logo-marquee 'trusted by' section (the anchor), a 4-up metric strip, a 3-up feature grid, a teal CTA card, and a footer. The `<header>` nav is `sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/70` with an inner `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8` -> `flex h-16 items-center justify-between` row (brand cluster left, `hidden md:flex` link row center, sign-in/Start-free/hamburger right). The hero `<section>` is `relative overflow-hidden grid-bg` with a top hairline gradient and a centered `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 pt-20 pb-16 text-center` column (status pill, the `max-w-3xl text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold` heading with the underlined teal 'recognizes', a `max-w-xl` lead, and a `flex flex-col sm:flex-row` button pair). The trusted/marquee `<section id="trusted">` is `border-y border-slate-200 bg-white py-14`: a centered uppercase `tracking-[0.18em]` label, then two `.marquee-wrap edge-fade overflow-hidden` rows, each holding a flex `.marquee-track` (or `.marquee-track-rev .marquee-fast`) whose logo chips are injected by JS and duplicated for a seamless loop. The metric `<section>` is `bg-slate-50` with a `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 py-12` -> a `grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-200` strip of four white cells (so the gap-px on a slate-200 bg reads as hairline dividers), each a big teal-700 extrabold number + a slate-500 label. The feature `<section id="features">` is `bg-white py-20` with a left-aligned `max-w-2xl` heading/lead + a `mt-12 grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6` of three bordered slate-50 cards (icon chip + title + body) that turn white and lift on hover. The CTA `<section>` is `bg-slate-50 pb-20` wrapping a `relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-teal-700 px-8 py-14 sm:px-14 text-center` card with corner glow blobs + a faint white grid + a heading/lead + a white 'Start designing free' pill. The `<footer>` is `border-t border-slate-200 bg-white` with a `py-10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between` row (brand / copyright / social icons). Responsive: below md the nav links collapse into the hamburger, the hero heading scales `text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl -> lg:text-6xl` and the button pair stacks, the metric grid is `grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-4`, the feature grid is one column -> `md:grid-cols-3`, and the footer stacks.

special_ui_components.prompt: The anchor is a TWO-ROW logo marquee built from CSS keyframes, not a JS scroll loop. Define `@keyframes marquee { from { transform: translateX(0) } to { transform: translateX(-50%) } }` and a mirror `@keyframes marquee-rev { from { translateX(-50%) } to { translateX(0) } }`. `.marquee-track { display:flex; width:max-content; animation: marquee 40s linear infinite }` and `.marquee-track-rev { display:flex; width:max-content; animation: marquee-rev 50s linear infinite }`, with `.marquee-fast { animation-duration: 28s }` applied to the second row so it scrolls right faster. Each track's innerHTML is built in JS: a `buildTrack(list)` returns the logo-item HTML for the list TWICE (two identical `<div class="flex shrink-0 items-center group">` groups), so when the track translates by -50% it lands exactly on the duplicate and the loop is seamless. `document.querySelector('.marquee-track').innerHTML = buildTrack(logosA)` and `.marquee-track-rev` = `buildTrack(logosB)`.

Each marquee logo is a `logoItem(icon, name)` chip: `<div class="logo-item flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3 mx-6 sm:mx-8 transition">` holding a `grid h-12 w-12 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 transition-colors` icon square (a 26px Iconify Phosphor icon) + a `text-[21px] font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-600 transition-colors` wordmark. By default the chip is slate-600 monochrome; on hover the single chip tints teal via CSS: `.logo-item:hover .iconify, .logo-item:hover span { color: #0f766e }` and `.logo-item:hover > span:first-child { background: #ccfbf1 }` (the icon square fills teal-100). The two logo lists are arrays of [icon, name] pairs -- row A: ph:lightning-fill/Voltic, ph:cube-fill/Northbox, ph:planet-fill/Orbit, ph:diamond-fill/Lumen, ph:hexagon-fill/Hexa, ph:flower-lotus-fill/Bloom, ph:triangle-fill/Apex, ph:circles-three-fill/Trio; row B: ph:waves-fill/Marina, ph:mountains-fill/Ridge, ph:compass-fill/Vantage, ph:shield-check-fill/Aegis, ph:rocket-launch-fill/Liftoff, ph:tree-fill/Canopy, ph:atom-fill/Nucleo, ph:crown-fill/Regal.

Each marquee row sits in a `.marquee-wrap edge-fade overflow-hidden` container. `.edge-fade` applies a horizontal mask so the logos fade to transparent at both ends instead of hard-cutting: `-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 8%, #000 92%, transparent); mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 8%, #000 92%, transparent)`. Hovering anywhere on a row pauses BOTH tracks: `.marquee-wrap:hover .marquee-track, .marquee-wrap:hover .marquee-track-rev { animation-play-state: paused }`, so the user can read a logo by hovering.

The metric strip fakes hairline dividers without per-cell borders: a `grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-200` container whose children are `bg-white px-6 py-7 text-center` cells. Because the grid background is slate-200 and the gap is exactly 1px, the gaps between the white cells read as crisp 1px dividers, and `overflow-hidden` + `rounded-2xl` clips it into a single bordered card.

The hero ground is a faint teal graph-paper grid: `.grid-bg { background-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(15,118,110,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(15,118,110,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 44px 44px }`. A single thin accent line runs across the very top of the hero: an `absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-teal-600/30 to-transparent` gradient hairline that fades in from the sides.

The hero's accent word 'recognizes' gets a hand-drawn underline: inside a `relative whitespace-nowrap text-teal-700` span, place an `absolute -bottom-1.5 left-0 w-full` inline `<svg height=10 viewBox='0 0 300 10' preserveAspectRatio='none'>` with a single `<path d='M2 7C60 2.5 240 2.5 298 7' stroke='#0f766e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>` -- a slightly bowed, round-capped teal swash at 40% opacity that reads as a marker underline beneath the word.

The CTA is a `relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-teal-700 px-8 py-14 sm:px-14 text-center` card lit from the corners: a `absolute -right-20 -top-24 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-teal-400/30 blur-3xl` bright blob top-right and a `absolute -left-24 -bottom-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-teal-900/60 blur-3xl` dark blob bottom-left, plus a faint `absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.07]` white 36px line grid (inline `linear-gradient(to right,#fff 1px,transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom,#fff 1px,transparent 1px); background-size:36px 36px`). All content is `relative` so it sits above the atmosphere, and the button is a white pill with `text-teal-700`.

structured.special_notes:
Exact tokens (Tailwind config extend): `fontFamily.sans = ['Inter','system-ui','sans-serif']`; colors `teal: { 600: '#0f766e', 700: '#0d6660', 800: '#115e59', 50: '#f0fdfa', 100: '#ccfbf1' }`, `ink: '#0b1220'`, `slate: { 50: '#f8fafc' }`. Fonts: Inter only (Google Fonts weights 400;500;600;700;800;900). Icons: Iconify 3.1.1 Phosphor (`ph:`) set from https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js. Body `font-sans text-ink antialiased` with `body { background: #f8fafc }` and `html { scroll-behavior: smooth }`. One accent family (teal) carries all brand + action; slate-600 body, slate-500 labels, near-black ink (#0b1220) headings. Marquee CSS: `@keyframes marquee { translateX(0) -> translateX(-50%) }`, `@keyframes marquee-rev { translateX(-50%) -> translateX(0) }`; `.marquee-track { display:flex; width:max-content; animation: marquee 40s linear infinite }`, `.marquee-track-rev { animation: marquee-rev 50s linear infinite }`, `.marquee-fast { animation-duration: 28s }` (so row 1 scrolls left 40s, row 2 scrolls right 28s); `.marquee-wrap:hover` pauses both tracks (`animation-play-state: paused`). `.edge-fade { mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 8%, #000 92%, transparent) }` (+ -webkit-). Logos are built in JS: two [icon,name] arrays (logosA, logosB), a `logoItem(icon,name)` returns a `.logo-item flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3 mx-6 sm:mx-8` chip (a `h-12 w-12 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-600` icon square with a 26px ph icon + a `text-[21px] font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-600` wordmark), and `buildTrack(list)` returns the items TWICE so a translateX(-50%) loop is seamless; `.marquee-track`.innerHTML = buildTrack(logosA), `.marquee-track-rev`.innerHTML = buildTrack(logosB). Per-logo teal hover: `.logo-item:hover .iconify, .logo-item:hover span { color:#0f766e }`, `.logo-item:hover > span:first-child { background:#ccfbf1 }`.
